title: IMF总裁点名美国：债务已超出安全区间，德国为何成唯一例外？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You sound a new precaution saying that governments need to take urgent action, which governments, which countries in particular need to act now?
segments.zh: 您发出新的警示，称各国政府需采取紧急行动，哪些国家尤其需要立即行动？

segments.en: The most important group of countries because of their systemic significance are advanced economies.
segments.zh: 因其系统重要性，最重要的国家群体是发达经济体。

segments.en: What we have seen over the last years, since COVID, is advanced economies are hit by a shock.
segments.zh: 自疫情以来，我们所见的是发达经济体遭受冲击。

segments.en: They rush to the rescue of their people and their businesses on its own.
segments.zh: 它们迅速出手救助本国民众和企业。

segments.en: This is a novel objective, but shock after shock, deficits and debts have been going up.
segments.zh: 这是一个新目标，但冲击接连不断，赤字和债务持续上升。

segments.en: And on the other side, we have the current shock, the energy shock that is pushing inflation up and interest rates up, making that service much more expensive.
segments.zh: 另一方面，当前能源冲击推高通胀和利率，使偿债成本更加昂贵。

segments.en: So, in this environment, delay no more.
segments.zh: 因此，在这种环境下，不能再拖延。

segments.en: Governments where debt levels are very high, and that service costs are very high as well.
segments.zh: 债务水平非常高、偿债成本也非常高的政府。

segments.en: Where deficits have gone out of the safe zone they should be, they need to act with no delay.
segments.zh: 赤字已超出安全区间的国家，必须立即行动。

segments.en: Of course, these are the countries that include the likes of the US.
segments.zh: 当然，这些国家包括美国等。

segments.en: Japan, France, Italy, Germany is one happy exception because of long history of fiscal discipline.
segments.zh: 日本、法国、意大利、德国是难得的例外，因为有着长期的财政纪律。
